answer.explanation: From 23:06:44Z to 23:07:57Z, CrudApiFunction logged many AccessDeniedException errors on dynamodb:PutItem against table/missing-table. The live TABLE_NAME is 'missing-table', and LastModified is 23:06:31Z, just before the window. The SAM template hardcodes TABLE_NAME: missing-table instead of referencing CartTable (!Ref CartTable), so the intended state is wrong and live matches it. Because live and IaC agree, the drift is not in the live config alone; the faulty template value is the origin. The role policy correctly grants PutItem on CartTable, so the IAM error is a symptom of the wrong table name, not a missing permission. No commit history tool was available, so no commit hash is given.
